title: Artifact-Gated Evaluation of a Causal FIR Module for Sequential Recommendation
description: UNPUBLISHED CANDIDATE METADATA. Code, pre-declarations, provenance manifests, and evaluation artifacts for a narrow modular study of a gradient-active left-causal depthwise FIR residual in an HSTU-style sequential recommender. The bundle includes a fail-closed evidence graph that recomputes 198 active paper cells across 22 families and symmetrically retains positive, null, deviated, and VOID outcomes. Outcome-known Amazon studies include a compound pointwise-placebo contrast that does not isolate temporal access. A prospectively frozen MovieLens 1M study did not replicate learned FIR versus identity or pointwise; smaller FIR arms met the noninferiority margin only conditionally on that failed effect gate. An official-code WEARec equal-evaluation feasibility run scored below the existing full-model reference; architecture and tuning budgets were not equalized. The evidence does not support a broad SOTA claim, paired superiority over single-run comparators, per-channel-tap necessity, independent confirmation, or generalization. Amazon Reviews 2023 and MovieLens 1M records are not redistributed; the public MovieLens and WEARec graph cells are aggregate-only and cannot replay private endpoints. Public assets and regeneration paths are SHA-256-pinned by RELEASE_MANIFEST.json. Replace the creator placeholder and verify legal/licensing fields before any release or DOI publication.
